note: Derived from ledger.json. Ready means every prerequisite is proved or imported. Downstream counts obligations that depend on the row through deps or hypotheses.

ready.statement: For KKL’s exact non-locally-connected natural projection, prove the geometric two-level lift through the required horizon: pi^(-1)(L_(0,com)^n)=L_0^n for the selected predecessors, and pi(K_i) is contained in the corresponding geometric model small-Julia continuum bar K_i. Since model incidence gives bar K_i subset L_(0,com)^n, these clauses force K_i subset L_0^n. Record separately failure of the selected full-preimage equality and failure of physical/model continuum correspondence; an abstract finite-tree vertex is not a point of the geometric model.

Prove conditional proof-used compatibility through H=b+2: every independently supplied depth-n proper restriction whose deep endpoint follows the declared central small-Julia parent itinerary lands in the canonical Q_0-selected component L_0^n and carries its actual-component address w_n. This is a universal compatibility assertion only; it does not construct the restriction, its endpoint occurrence, or its host. Those existential clauses remain in the incoming-window anchor, so no occurrence is assumed circularly.

For the canonical Q_0-selected chain through H=b+2, prove in the full physical carrier that Q_0 separates alpha^0 from L_0^1 and, for every 1<=n<H, Q_n separates alpha^n from L_0^(n+1). Construct the proof-used collars and marked accesses and prove that competing carrier routes outside the selected inverse sheet do not bypass Q_n. Applying phi_0 inside one sheet is insufficient because a separating path in the full carrier may leave that sheet.

Complete the target-first source boundary map for the active KKL Wave, Value, WAD, translation-marking, and Wanderers program by binding every symbol and universal geometric restriction, assigning every atomic source occurrence and prose invocation to its exact typed demand, and filling the total theorem-hypothesis/formal-to-actual substitution table. Parameterized lifts remain separately typed from the entire geometric restriction. The generated lexical occurrence manifest and overlapping D/W/T display buckets are inputs, not a completed source package.
Every virtual-molecule block admits a monotone finite cell-tree quotient of its dynamically relevant Cantor carrier with universal atomic and gate incidence and compatible partial cellular dynamics.

Every actual finite virtual stage cycle admits compatible selected relative-cover lifts that are embedded on relatively compact Jordan cores, preserve the full component and deck-phase route, and retain the propagated critical value after the unique quadratic stage, so that the planar critical-spine compiler produces a closed degree-two selected return.

After an actual target base is typed or uniquely selected, every demanded finite-cylinder branch image has the open pullback component forced by INTERIOR_PULLBACK_COMPONENT_FORCING, and that reached localized component, or the globally identical component justified by the Jordan-disk component lemma, is one of the declared equal-depth target cylinders at every proof-used intermediate iterate with complete metadata and enlargement stability.

Before any stopping execution, every actual virtual-Molecule block has a source-faithful syntactic continuation relation that is sound for actual branch-component extensions, complete for every Wave, Wanderers, covering, quasi-additivity, and width theorem call, stable under certified root enlargement, and independent of the desired bounds, compactness, rigidity, and MLC conclusions.

For every direct-decoration infinite address, construct the actual multisector Bottcher angular footprint with compatible inverse lifts and prove that the exterior traces of the nested puzzle cylinders form a fundamental chain cofinal at one external prime end, including endpoint addresses, so that its impression is exactly the nested end fiber. Protection against collars, obstacles, and enlargement is separate.

Prove the marked-interval combinatorial-growth implication used by KKL’s bounded-visits lemma: establish the exact at-most 6b+k-1 count for length-k multi-intervals meeting the critical limb, obtain correctly indexed repetition only from a strict pigeonhole excess, and prove an interval-level no-periodicity or strict-growth statement. Global Perron-Frobenius expansion lambda_F>1 alone may not be cited as excluding a periodic marked interval.

Construct a valid coefficient-one Wave pushforward theorem for the actual proof-used stationary source class. Either prove that every such source is one coherent single-crest or single-WAD-coordinate packet to which a complete DL-style logarithmic pruning proof applies, or replace coefficient one by a multiplicity-aware estimate with all repeated source conductance coordinates charged. The theorem must define boundary degree and document constants independent of period, horizon, access count, selector history, and leaf.

On the entire nonshort ambient-singleton BL_0-ending stationary survivor, make a Borel first-horizon partition with no duplicated transverse mass and construct two full-width leafwise-paired genuine source Waves with disjoint untrimmed target occurrence images at the same actual L_0^h occurrence. The typed start must be DIRECT_WAVE, an actually eligible FREUDENTHAL end on an access-splitting localization, or an ACCESS_LOCAL RLS-A+ product seed; an ideal access is never relabeled as a topological end. Prove exact complete image identities, seed-side properness when needed, source-lamination validity, fine/coarse filter survival, whole-ending-multi-interval degrees, omitted-family zero-width or explicit V(F)/R(F) charge, and first-horizon/no-duplication accounting. The first failed typed-start, exit, pairing, marking, degree, or accounting predicate is the obstruction certificate. Ledger role: optional alternative

For the exact projection and lift meant by KKL lines 542-543, prove through H=b+2 that the model is a dendrite, pi is a continuous monotone surjective semiconjugacy, pi(alpha^n)=alpha_(n,com) for every selected predecessor, the fixed alpha fiber is a singleton, T=pi^(-1)(T_com), pi maps the physical critical point to the model critical point, pi(Q_n) lies in the selected model inverse sheet Omega_(n,com), and each marked physical small-Julia continuum K_i maps into its corresponding geometric model continuum bar K_i. Monotonicity, semiconjugacy, and the singleton fixed fiber then force every selected predecessor fiber to be a singleton. The geometric continua bar K_i are not the abstract vertices obtained by a later finite-tree quotient; collapsing K_i to such a point would conflict with finite-orbit injectivity of the canonical monotone model. The locked KKL and Dudko-Lyubich passages state a natural semiconjugating projection and an unspecified lift, but do not state all these identifications. Ledger role: optional alternative

At the final stationary subwave Y_(N-1), construct a partition Y_(N-1)=G disjoint-union D modulo zero width in KKL’s native transverse width measure, with the restrictions of that measure agreeing with the proof-used lamination widths. Every leaf of G must have the actual segmented final incidence and measurable route realization needed for the corrected degree-two estimate, while all untyped encounters, continuation exits, nonlanding, marking/filter loss, window incompatibility, terminal-family failures, deck collisions, and measurable-incidence failures in D satisfy W(D)<=a_b W(U minus T)+c_b W(RF)+c_b. Constants depend only on b, and use in the source-wide induction requires the native HTND absolute scale or an explicit W(A)>=C(R(F)+1) hypothesis.

Classify the restricted psi-ql direct-decoration stages, if any, on which the full bold ambient annulus immersion and full glued pseudo-piece inclusion are globally univalent. The former universal route is unavailable: KL_CANONICAL_LOCALIZATION_FORCED_COLLISION proves a nontrivial subgroup-kernel collision at every ordinary primitive canonical-localization seed, and propagates it to the exact direct-decoration depths whenever the same seed carries the KL decoration data. This is now a non-gating restricted-class question; it may not be used by the universal footprint, contact-closure, VAAPC-I, UPTCR, or MLC chains.

For every actual fixed Kahn–Lyubich direct-decoration inclusion tile L_i, determine the stronger central-image saturation equality L_i^(-1)(tilde e_j(P_j))=e_i(Q_i), or the corresponding equality on any retained proof-used collar whose theorem explicitly needs it. This full equality is not required for injectivity of the full glued pseudo-piece: the collision-relevant equality over tilde e_j(Q_i) follows automatically from full tile injectivity and component bijectivity. A failure over p in P_j minus Q is a saturation, footprint, or collar-exhaustion defect rather than an interior quotient collision; record its component, sheet, access, itinerary, and target-central location. This is a non-gating open question for the full interior embedding but may remain a hypothesis of stronger carrier or footprint statements.

Extend the conformal-disk/ideal-circle theorem to V_esc and every proof-used first-return phase P_{i,k}. For each piece verify the finite open-star cover and prove two omitted values or ambient hyperbolicity; then identify Kahn’s trivial-deck ideal boundary with the conformal circle and scope continuous extension to actual puzzle-inclusion immersions. A closed gluing plus an assumed ambient Riemann map is insufficient.

For the optional Freudenthal fixed-end route and every proof-used stationary horizon h<=b+2, first construct an access-splitting localization and actual eligible Freudenthal source ends; a marked BL_0 or L_0^h access may not be relabeled as such an end. Then prove the six route-specific certificates C_h^-,X_h^-,C_h^+,X_h^+,P_h,M_h: proper degree-one oriented starting ends, same-occurrence exits, full common-leaf/window/sheet/access coupling, and native filter/Wave-image survival. Under TWO_h and INC_h the unsplit physical inner end is nonproper, but those hypotheses are not promoted unconditionally. This fixed-end route is sufficient neither for family-level full-width pairing nor for transverse accounting, and it is not logically necessary if actual paired source Waves are constructed by an access-local or direct method.

For every proof-used horizon h<=b+2, prove either that the optimized prefix-compatible collar conductance is at most C_b(W(U minus T)+1), together with measurable source first-exit selection, or directly that the sum of marked route-exit conductances is at most that quantity. C_b must be independent of satellite period, rotation denominator, route depth within the fixed horizon, and the individual block. Qualitative collar existence and Kahn’s response in the larger full width W(F) are insufficient.

For KKL’s non-locally-connected rational-lamination lift, identify the physical lifted carrier and the nondividing fixed-point fiber precisely enough to prove that the physical carrier omits that fiber and is a proper subcontinuum of K. The locked one-line instruction to lift the combinatorial objects does not by itself establish the needed inverse-image equality or fiber exclusion.

blocked.statement: Global physical line-1598 marked-core incidence MCI_b says that if the canonical selected L_0^b intersects the original physical Hubbard carrier T, then it contacts an actual component K of the primitive small-Julia cycle. The theorem is proved for locally connected physical K(F), and whole-continuum incidence is proved in the locally connected combinatorial model. The exact remaining model-lift route is the non-locally-connected selected full-preimage and geometric small-Julia-continuum correspondence theorem; an abstract vertex of the later finite-tree quotient is not a point of the geometric model.

Within a stationary block with parabolically b-bounded primitive renormalization, rotation 1/q, and explicit high-type inequality q>b, bind the complete-horizon selected chain to the proof-used Wave components and, for every n in {b,b+1}, h=n+1, and actual alpha in A_h to which KKL line 1603 is applied, construct a specified incoming-side germ at one marked L_0^h contact and its connected host C. Prove that C is an embedded component-maximal proper restriction, the deep access is the upper endpoint c<1 of its canonical window (a,c), the other end is alpha’s actual lifted BL_0 endpoint access, and a=0. The marked access may be obtained through EGC_H or by a separate direct theorem; EGC_H is not a logically necessary factorization. Multiple components at the same coarse locus must be exhausted or canonically selected. On failure distinguish: no typed incoming germ/component; wrong one-sided incidence; retracing or nonmaximal representative; nonlanding or noninterior deep end; a>0; or a=0 with the wrong BL_0 lift.

Within the same parabolically b-bounded stationary high-type context with rotation 1/q and q>b, for every proof-used b<=n<N-1, if an actual alpha in A_(n+1) fails the source pass-through predicate at the corrected Q_n continuum, construct two segmented retained extension towers realizing exactly the two topological portions named at KKL line 1603. The incoming tower must be anchored at alpha’s BL_0 end and terminate at one specified L_0^(n+1) contact; the outgoing tower must start at that same contact occurrence and terminate at alpha’s non-BL_0 end. At every stage record the full proper restriction path, its actual occurrence window in the preceding full output, endpoint intervals and accesses, sheet, parent and attachment provenance, filter witness, and covering image; prove complete prefix compatibility and terminal Wave membership.

For every proof-used selected Q_s pull in KKL’s stationary horizon, first realize the full-carrier Q-separator predicate, then prove that the root and deep parent routes determine nonempty disjoint marked prime-end sets, retain their complete side, cyclic-order, sheet, parent, and endpoint-interval data through every selected conformal pull and immersion filter, and yield the ordered access records required at the central quadratic collar. Continuum separation in one inverse sheet or a coarse component label alone is insufficient.

Within the same parabolically b-bounded stationary high-type context with rotation 1/q and q>b, for every proof-used b<=n<N-1 and every actual occurrence alpha in KKL’s A_(n+1) that avoids the corrected Q_n continuum, prove that each line-1603 route has a complete segmented extension tower: every full one-step restriction is proper, belongs to the applicable fine marking, survives the coarse single-interval filter, and is connected to the next full output by its actual nested occurrence window; the final full output must be a Wave in the declared marking. Record the first failed continuation, remote ideal end, window, filter, or terminal membership.

Within the same parabolically b-bounded stationary high-type context with rotation 1/q and q>b, for each retained line-1603 portion construct one connected crosscut in the selected corrected Q_n collar and prove that its complete target-collar occurrence under the full fiber-product projection equals the image under the selected degree-two map G_n, with no additional entry, exit, re-entry, ambient sheet change, or late enlargement. Local germ containment is insufficient.

For the two actual retained and corridor-confined portions at every proof-used stationary index, prove the exact geometric predicate that their selected collar crosscuts are not related by the nontrivial deck involution of the unique central degree-two collar. It is sufficient, but not necessary, to prove that their complete unordered prime-end access pairs are not deck-related; with independently proved endpoint roles and orientations one may use the sharper ordered non-transposition certificate. Equality of the deck-related crosscut paths is the exact obstruction and requires an occurrence/deck-phase replacement state.

Under KKL’s complete stationary-Wave and ideal-marking hypotheses in the parabolically b-bounded high-type context with rotation 1/q and q>b, for every proof-used b<=n<N-1, if a leaf occurrence in A_(n+1) avoids the corrected Q_n continuum, combine retained portion realization, complete marked-access itineraries, selected-corridor confinement, and the exact selected-collar path predicate [lambda^+] != [tau_n(lambda^-)] to prove that the two terminal Wave occurrences have distinct proper images under the full f^(n+1) projection. Inequality of unordered endpoint pairs is only a sufficient certificate; equality of the untagged geometric images is the exact failure certificate and forces an occurrence/deck-phase replacement state.

Within KKL’s parabolically b-bounded stationary high-type context with rotation 1/q and q>b, for n=b and n=b+1 and every actual occurrence alpha in A_(n+1) avoiding the corrected Q_n continuum, construct the two line-1603 portions as retained proper depth-(n+1) components tied to the same leaf and stopping horizon; prove complete fine-marking and coarse-subordination survival and prove that their f^(n+1)-images are distinct unparametrized terminal marked paths. Record the stage, sheet, parent component, entry and exit accesses, fine and coarse ends, and terminal images. This is a pointwise break certificate and asserts no doubled-width paired-Wave response.

Freeze an actual finite, target-first ledger of every theorem call, target curve-family schema, ideal interval, and universal KKL subordination query used by Wave, Wanderers, domination, quasi-additivity, covering, or width comparison on the complete direct-decoration horizon. In KKL’s actual stationary Wave branch, with parabolic bound b and N=b+3, prove that every occurrence in the defined A_(N-1)=A_(b+2) passes through both corrected source continua Q_b and Q_(b+1) in the successive-pullback sense. This requires the full-carrier separator/access theorem and the two-sided Wave noncollision theorem validating line 1603; it asserts no final component incidence, order, proper restriction, or width.

Legacy composite formulation: for m=b+2 and the actual final component over K_0^(m-1), prove that KKL’s depth-m pass-through predicate produces a retained proper path in U^m minus Kcal^m from that component to Kcal^m minus it, including connected occurrence transport, restriction-filter survival, prime-end landing, the non-locally-connected rational-lamination model, measurable lamination assembly, and W(A_m)<=W(B). This does not certify degree on the whole marked end or a pushforward-width estimate; the active native route separates those clauses.

Every actual finite virtual horizon supplies the open mapping telescope together with exact depth-q core identities, iterated covering embeddings, protected carrier-complement prime-end action, compatible relative covers, proper or end-proper proof-used intervals, and exact enlargement squares, so that the planar telescope identity promotes to a closed depth-q psi-ql correspondence.

For every retained occurrence in KKL’s stationary A_(N-1), prove that the two separately established shallower pass-through predicates refine to incidences with C_b and C_(b+1) in one actual component, or one source-faithful finite ordered component chain, of the final restriction in U^(N-1) minus Kcal^(N-1). Retain every intervening component and record the first split, missing end lift, or occurrence mismatch.

Finite virtual postcritical data inflate to locally saturated depth-q psi-ql stages whose selected return is degree two, whose required pullbacks are admissible through the stopping time, and whose localization loss is uniformly relative or amortized.

After final graph-lift realization, prove a nested-domain and unique-or-controlled-crossing theorem in U^(N-1) that orders the two final component incidences for every retained oriented restriction, including repeated incidences. Separate-level separation statements do not by themselves determine the final order.

Every extracted cell tree lifts to an access-complete prime-end marked analytic correspondence satisfying finite-horizon psi-ql axioms, exact KKL translation rules, bounded incidence, standard-width charge, and controlled parallel replication.

For every realized finite virtual copy-chain prefix, equal-depth source cylinder, and source-defined return branch, there is a unique actual target base and cylinder containing the image component, compatibly with geometric parents, the partial pre-root shift, the separate root transition, complete marked metadata, presentation, and authorized root enlargement.

Retain the adjacent tagged terminal half-access occurrences, tile, deck, order, multiplicity, localization, obstacle, and final-root data, and prove a uniform response-class/depth charge or record the first B1–B10 failure.

This is a width selector, not an equality between original KKL and KL prime ends.

Preserve multiple ideal incidences and record the first wrong tag, central endpoint, or competing occurrence; physical vertex incidence alone is insufficient.

Every actual intermediate virtual-Molecule scale has an analytically realized compact address space of actual small-Julia components with exact polynomial branch, return, parent, sheet, critical-address, escape, localization, presentation, terminal-compatibility, and final-root-enlargement data, constructed without downstream width, compactness, or rigidity conclusions.

For every stage named by DIRECT_DECORATION_WAVE_PROOF_USE_LEDGER, construct rather than assume the actual same-source canonical/KL seed, source and target labels, lifted basepoints, localization subgroups, separately typed dynamical covering and inclusion immersion, central chart, tile charts, and exact central/tile seam equalizers, and instantiate the proved relation spans on that glued datum. On every aligned stage, construct the tagged end-compactified geometric inverse-trace path space for every proof-use family, classify proper source paths and their actual KL, canonical relative-or-limit-defect, and target ideal-or-interior endpoint frames, retain all 0/1/>=2/infinite restriction multiplicities and subordination predicates, construct every iota^*I, prove pulled partial-marking disjointness and refinement by g^*I, and only then prove immersion properness on every whole proof-used interval and every complete end-interval required for KKL end-properness. For every classified proof-use geometric restriction family, retain every component and limit contact with zero omission or construct an explicit nonnegative omitted-family WAD/Value response, prove row-space and Value observability, and bound the complete transition charge by universal constants independent of satellite period, rotation number, and horizon length. PARAMETRIZED_PULLBACK_KKL_EXHAUSTION_NO_GO forbids a bounded-sheet or raw-width shortcut. This node contains no final-root enlargement claim.

For every actual virtual-Molecule block, finite provisional root package, and compatible finite return path, there is a nondegenerate full forward-coherent carrier containing all critical values of the return, with an actual covering/inclusion complement pair, compatible cusp-free localizations, exact selected-component routing, and a complete absorb-or-separate obstacle ledger.

The first born, lost, or merged sheet, component, proper path, endpoint, access, obstacle, or bridge is the obstruction certificate. This geometric theorem is independent of the relation width-response estimate.

After the complete proof-use ledger, actual canonical/KL stage alignment, tagged geometric inverse-trace proper-path and whole-end-interval classification, and uniform relation response are constructed, determine the physical complement-access footprint of every retained lambda, xi, and eta source end on every source label, sheet, coset, and deck phase. Every virtual-Molecule block has an access-complete selected finite-horizon correspondence whose resolved tokens carry the exact typed source-column incidence B=N^T, KKL left/right Value weights, endpoint frames, raw WAD transport, and WAD-to-core incidence through every proof-used stopping time.

Every virtual provisional complement pair has a normalized relative-cover phase, complete prime-end endpoint and interval data, exact covering-versus-immersion endpoint containment, all required proper/end-proper flags, and commuting analytic and prime-end squares under every certified collision-free package enlargement.

Then prove the KKL universal pullback predicates, maximal safe-set components, pairwise disjoint pulled partial marking, refinement by the dynamical covering marking, and properness or end-properness on every complete proof-used interval. Every competing proper path, nonproper bridge, target-interior endpoint, source label, sheet, coset, deck phase, and response contribution must be retained or explicitly excluded. Every actual virtual-Molecule block has a horizon-independent prefix-closed language of admissible finite return words and, for every finite provisional root package and compatible word, an actual marked hyperbolic carrier complement and covering/immersion pair whose pulled marking refines the immersed marking, whose marked action is exact, whose used intervals are proper or end-proper, and whose component, access, obstacle, degree, and localization data commute with every certified collision-free package enlargement.

The state must retain the separately typed immersion-restriction and covering-transport factors, together with the fiber-product or Beck-Chevalley interchange data needed for word composition; multiplying one-step endomorphisms is not a substitute.

After the complete source-faithful horizon and marked current-separator incidence state are frozen, every proof-used unequal-footprint, access, obstacle, response, ideal, enlargement, and transported-contact trace atom has a proved finite last-live stage, or admits a future-faithful compact quotient preserving every response and Value observable. Raw contact localization for one nested chain does not supply this marked analytic frontier.

For every proof-used direct-decoration end, choose and source-lock the actual branch package and the restricted canonical-to-KL interface certified upstream; construct its physical cells and complete marked current-separator trace interfaces on that asserted domain; retain the least compatible multi-port response state, incidence-valued boundary transport, stage-normalized protected overlay, phase, orientation, and separately typed pulled-versus-immersed trace factors; prove safe closed elimination or compact retention, no-bypass resistance or full-response coercivity, fiber-product word composition, final-root no-new-sheet naturality, and sufficient uniform control for every claimed transition margin.
